scene: The glass lift whisks you to the multi-transit plaza.
picture: A flat side view along the open-air roof transit plaza. Far left, a yellow delivery truck idles with open rear doors. Left of centre sits the glass elevator shaft. Centre, the player in her purple wheelchair rolls onto the platform. Right, a puffing striped steam train waits beside a moored brass airship on the far right.
shown: a yellow delivery truck with open back doors idling on the far left
a striped steam train puffing sweet pink smoke waiting on the right
a moored brass airship with an extended ramp floating on the far right
